title.narrative: Enhancing role of the Lebanese security sector in stabilisation and reforms processes

description.narrative:
The project focuses on providing multidimensional support to Lebanese Internal Security Forces (ISF) while addressing needs for broader security sector reforms reflecting on the condition of the ISF and the level of trust towards the agency (community engagement and communication; prisons reforms and coordination). Support comes in critical period when stability of Lebanon is largely fragilized by the conflict and economic crisis, and when the role of the ISF as critical actor of security sector governance and stability mechanism is becoming yet more important.
The project will focus on 2 main areas of intervention over two years: Focus area 1: ISF community engagement mechanism Focus Area 2: Emergency support to prison overcrowding and policy reforms
IMPACT: Strengthened trust between communities and the ISF and greater stability in Lebanon, including in conflict-affected areas in the South.
OUTCOME 1: ISF adopt and implement people-centered security provision through inclusive and effective community engagement. OUTPUT 1.1: ISF provided with assistance to strengthen capacities on effective, inclusive, and gender-sensitive community engagement.
OUTCOME 2: Policy makers engaged in the process of fostering ISF and justice actors improve rights-compliant detention governance in line with national and international norms and standards. OUTPUT 2.1: A legal-assistance mechanism to support case handling of release procedures established, in coordination with NHRC/CPT and ISF OUTPUT 2.2: Technical and operational assistance to the reform process of the policies on the prison system is provided.
